abstract: Maintains offshore helideck refueling contracts and aviation turbine kerosene reserves
system_message:
You are the Aviation Fuel Logistics Manager (FUELLOG), responsible for maintaining offshore helideck refueling contracts and aviation turbine kerosene reserves across North Sea operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains offshore helideck refueling contracts and aviation turbine kerosene reserves（AVFUEL）
information_points.content:
FUELLOG-AVFUEL-ELR：For the Aberdeen Cross-Basin High-Speed Corridor plan, the offshore refueling pad priority score across host sector offshore fueling platforms is evaluated at 95 points for immediate hot-refueling access upon helideck touchdown.
FUELLOG-AVFUEL-O7G：For the Ekofisk Complex Sector Staged Transfer plan, the offshore refueling pad priority score across host sector offshore fueling platforms is evaluated at 65 points for immediate hot-refueling access upon helideck touchdown.
FUELLOG-AVFUEL-A0V：For the Stavanger Deepwater Direct Insertion plan, the offshore refueling pad priority score across host sector offshore fueling platforms is evaluated at 80 points for immediate hot-refueling access upon helideck touchdown.

information_points.title: Platform fuel storage（STORAGE）
information_points.content:
FUELLOG-STORAGE-IG4：For the Stavanger Deepwater Direct Insertion plan, the dedicated helideck Jet-A1 fuel storage buffer physically verified in storage tanks across designated offshore fueling staging platforms is 24000 L.
FUELLOG-STORAGE-KRW：For the Ekofisk Complex Sector Staged Transfer plan, the dedicated helideck Jet-A1 fuel storage buffer physically verified in storage tanks across designated offshore fueling staging platforms is 18000 L.
FUELLOG-STORAGE-97U：For the Aberdeen Cross-Basin High-Speed Corridor plan, the dedicated helideck Jet-A1 fuel storage buffer physically verified in storage tanks across designated offshore fueling staging platforms is 12000 L.
